title: Characteristics of Weather
seo_title: Primary 3 Basic Science: Characteristics of Weather Worksheets (NERDC)

standard_text: Weather is described by temperature, wind, cloud cover and rainfall, measured with instruments such as the thermometer, wind vane, anemometer and rain gauge. Weather data are recorded and interpreted, and NiMet (the Nigerian Meteorological Agency) gives forecasts. (summary of the Basic Science curriculum, Primary 3, theme: Learning About Our Environment)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 Basic Science worksheets (NERDC curriculum, theme: Learning About Our Environment): temperature, wind, clouds and rain, weather instruments, weather data and forecasts. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Weather is described by temperature, wind, clouds and rain.
body_html:
How to think about it

Weather is the condition of the air at a certain time and place. It is described by temperature (hot or cold), wind (speed and direction), clouds and rainfall. Weather can change quickly.

Instruments measure weather: a thermometer measures temperature, a wind vane shows wind direction, an anemometer measures wind speed, and a rain gauge measures rainfall. NiMet uses weather data to make forecasts.

Example

Which instrument shows wind direction?

An arrow on a pole

Answer: a wind vane

Example

Rainfall over 3 days: 5 mm, 10 mm, 15 mm. Total?

Add

Answer: 30 mm

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up the wind vane and the anemometer.
  • Thinking a forecast is always right.
  • Thinking clouds are made of smoke.
